caption: The drawing depicts a single antique flat iron, rendered in shades of grey and black, positioned against a plain, uncolored background. The iron has a triangular base with rounded edges, and the surface texture is depicted as rough and granular. Attached to the top of the base is a curved handle, which arches upward and connects to the base with ornate, bracket-like supports. There is a visible signature in the lower left corner of the image that reads "Maurice Van Pelt." The overall composition centers the iron on the paper, and there is no additional detail or objects surrounding it.
title: Flatiron
